title: Deferred a possible half-cent sales tax ballot measure
summary: News reports say the Council voted to defer a half-cent sales tax measure instead of placing it on the November 2026 ballot. The measure was estimated to raise $30 million to $35 million a year.
tally_note: Reported as unanimous by Hoodline (July 24, 2026), citing The Mercury News. We have not checked the official minutes.

title: Adopted the FY 2026/27 Operating Budget
summary: The Council adopted the budget after public hearings on June 2 and June 9. The proposed budget totaled $427.1 million and kept staffing and services at current-year levels, including the FY 2025/26 reductions.
source_title: The Fremont Connection, June 12, 2026 (City of Fremont)

title: Approved the FY 2025/26 budget rebalancing plan
summary: The plan covered $3.8 million in new labor costs with reductions in every department, including nine Police Department positions that are not sworn officers.
source_title: City Council Approves Budget Rebalancing (City of Fremont, Feb 13, 2026)

title: Adopted the FY 2025/26 Operating Budget
summary: The $392.4 million budget was balanced without using the Budget Uncertainty Reserve. Infrastructure maintenance spending was reduced by about $3 million.
source_title: Community Message from the City Manager on the FY 2025/26 Operating Budget
